ratings.comment: The G.O.A.T.
ratings.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

ratings.comment: She was super nice and helpful. Very knowledgeable about the topics and explained everything super well. Good class structure and labs that made it very interactive and easy to learn. I had her for CS 252 but for some reason its not a selectable option. 10/10 teacher

Doctor Rivoire is great, I had her for the computing professions class and she really made the class feel valuable. She gives awesome feedback, is very efficient with the short lecture time we have, and is hilarious. Only downside was the amount of HW sometimes felt a bit much for a 1 credit class. Great professor though, would take again!

Her lectures are really good and her grading is fair. Most of your grade (55%) relies on short, pretty easy quizzes that will happen almost every class session, and there are makeup opportunities for them. She really knows her stuff when it comes to hardware/architecture. Just try your best & participate in class and you will do just fine.

Dropped out of this class because it was brutal for no reason. Rivoire said that it was her first year teaching the class and that much was evident. Our first major project was the previous years' final project. She often taught lessons on critical topics only after we were handed assignments/projects on those topics. Terrible curriculum.

Had her for CS 315, CS 351, and CS 391 this fall. Unfortunately, she had stomach issues, RSV for a month, and a bad cold back-to-back. We didn't get any assignments graded (I'm walking blindly into finals), but it's ok because we just wanted her to be healthy. She is a very nice person, and she knows what she is talking about/super smart. 
:(

I have had Rivoire for multiple classes now, no matter how annoying the HW can be she does an excellent job and helping you if you get office hours with her. Her lectures are super engaging and she does a great job at helping you understand the material
Dr. Rivoire is fun, nice, caring. Will slow down and explain 2+2 for you if you need for it and wont mind.

She is very nice and enthusiastic, but is hard to reach through email. She is bad at giving hw back to you at a reasonable time. Expect to not know your grade for most of the semester. She stopped assigning hw after the midterm to catch up on grading. She then condensed the material into one assignment due the week before finals week.

Dr. Rivoire is a passionate and caring professor, but her grading is really bad. The end of the semester has rolled around and she has only graded two of our homework assignments. I feel totally in the dark about my grade despite having a good handle on the material. Be ready to feel stressed about not knowing where you're at in the course.
ratings.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

ratings.comment: Never, ever, ever responded to a single email I sent to any of her email accounts. Totally unreachable outside of class.

5 homework assignments, daily in class activities, 3 exams (non-cumulative final). Homework were tough and long. Activities are usually really easy and done in groups. Good lecturer, answers questions in class but good luck over email. Absolutely abhorrent grading practice. There's one week until the final and not a single thing has been graded.
ratings.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

ratings.comment: Based on the ratings here, I guess I got her in an off year. She knows her stuff, that's for sure, but that doesn't excuse her flaws. Impossible to reach outside of class, missed nearly a month of class and made us pay the price, and constantly made promises that she could not keep, such as having things graded by dates she announces.

Extremely disappointed in Rivoire. I can tell she has the potential to be an excellent professor, but her inability to grade anything by the time she promises is rough. She also makes mistakes in labs, missed many classes she had to assign a project a week before finals started. Unorganized and sloppy, but a nice woman.
Missed so many classes, and once an entire week of class. Continually pushed back projects and exams because how often she would skip, leaving everyone behind.
Canceled way too many classes. Labs often contained ambiguous instructions or mistakes. Does not respond to emails or canvas. Materials of exam were not covered in class. Will not recommend.

Dr. Rivoire is an awesome instructor. She knows her stuff and obviously works hard not only for students in her class, but she also works hard for all students in the department and the department as a whole.
ratings.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

ratings.comment: Great class, just too easy. She always gave us 5-10 minutes to discuss answers when 1 minute would be fine. Would have liked if she went over x2-x3 as much material.

Dr. Rivoire is a great lecturer and makes the material interesting, and easy to understand, but she was not great returning graded work. The core of your grade consists of HW and tests, and we didn't get any of that back until the day of the final. That's truly unacceptable... She's highly intelligent, loved the lectures, but room for improvement.
ratings.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Tests are tough--Would take again

ratings.comment: Easier than 351. Some in-class activities/labs, 3 exams. 4 HWs. HW2 very hard, and everyone failed HW4. HW1/HW3 are fine, and all the exams are not that difficult. No curves, not a very busy class. Textbook is useful. Overall not a bad class as long as you stay on top of things and start studying/HW well in advance. Do not fall behind either.
ratings.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

ratings.comment: Great teacher that clearly explains concepts, but moves a bit quickly. Pay close attention otherwise easy to fall behind. 4 large HWs, get started early. 2 midterms and 1 final. All tough but doable as long as you study, take notes, and visit her for help when necessary. Daily in class activity, use these to study and do HWs. 2 paper-like projects
ratings.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

ratings.comment: Dr Rivoire makes difficult topics easy to understand. Very detail oriented on exams. One of the best teachers i've had in the CS department.
ratings.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

ratings.comment: Great professor.
Rivoire was a great CS teacher to have for intro. She was very clear, helpful, and expected useful skills to be developed from her students. Also, a great connection to have in the CS department.
My favorite CS teacher at this school. Take every class you can get with her. She's quite difficult but you will learn more from this teacher than you will from any other two combined.
A great teacher. Literally award winning. If you cant learn CS from her then it can't be learned. Knows what she is talking about, and gets it across extremely clearly. I highly recommend.

She is absolutely one of the best teachers you will ever take a class from. She is generally caring for you as a student, willing to help always, extremely clear, and knows her stuff but she will pile on the homework, and her tests are challenging. If she is teaching a class you will learn from her. Take her!

Great teacher. She writes on the board and gives plenty of examples and always waits for questions and is willing to help. Supplemental reading will help, but it isn't mandatory. Labs are easy at first but quickly become challenging. If you have an interest in programming or computer science, take her class. Class currently taught in Python 3.
Can't miss a single class or you will fall behind. No surprises on the exams. Projects are pretty slow and dull. To stay fresh you need to practice on your own.
pros: she has nice personality and is organized.              cons: she's too fast in general. quiz every week, labs usually due by the end of class and a final exam at the end of the class.

I had her for two classes this semester, and I have to say she was awesome in both. She does a great job going over the material and helping you understand. She is definitely all about making sure you understand what is going on. She is knowledgeable and easy to talk to. I highly recommend her!

When I took 115 with her it was her first semester at SSU. What I got from class was helpful and informative, though at the time she taught straight out of the book. I had the lab section without her, so I don't know how she handles labs. Your grade depends on how you grasp programming..so...meh.
